task: Restore previously removed acceleration candidates on top of the committed R124 precision baseline and classify each as lossless or lossy

precision_baseline.what_it_is: R124 real 49-step original-50-layer 910A generation with its own FP16 encoder, original FP32 VAE/branch parameters and the verified FP16 range protections
precision_baseline.policy_from_user: This version is the precision baseline. Restore every previously removed acceleration; keep it when lossless, stop and ask the user when measurably lossy - an error inside the earlier 1% GPU-comparison tolerance is NOT auto-approved.

key_finding_baseline_is_not_bit_reproduc.consequence: Bit identity cannot gate any optimization on this device. A candidate is only called lossless when its deviation stays inside this measured self-repeat band; anything above it is reported as lossy.
key_finding_baseline_is_not_bit_reproduc.implication_for_round124: The five R124 GPU-comparison gates (0.036%-0.26% video, 0.056%-0.26% audio) sit inside this self-repeat band, so they demonstrate absence of gross implementation error, not operator-level bitwise agreement.

candidates_measured.candidate: whole DiT resident (remove per-block CPU staging)
candidates_measured.classification: unavailable at the baseline precision configuration
candidates_measured.measured: NPU out of memory: 31.06 GiB already allocated, 404 MiB allocation failed on all 8 ranks
candidates_measured.why: TP2 leaves 16539411712 FP16 parameter elements (30.8 GiB) per rank, which cannot coexist with activations in 32 GiB
candidates_measured.note: Becoming resident requires raising sharding (TP8/USP8), which changes reduction order and is therefore a lossy change that needs approval.

candidates_measured.candidate: static device tensor cache (upload invariant branch/context tensors once)
remove the FP32 patch/time projection guards (plain Half projections)
candidates_measured.conclusion: The FP32 residual protection in these four projections is numerically load-bearing, not conservative padding.

candidates_measured.candidate: region cost attribution of one warm evaluation
candidates_measured.caveat: Per-module synchronize inflates absolute seconds; only relative shares are meaningful.

lossless_accelerations_available_but_sma: R124-native vision positional-interpolation / rotary geometry memoization (recompute is small relative to the encoder's attention cost)
R124-native text RoPE table memoization under fail-closed keys
VAE geometry-only caches: token ids, tabulated RoPE cos/sin, split_tiles / temporal frame plan
VAE mean/std and blend weight caching where the original tensors are reused unchanged
Fixed-shape tile gather workspace removing the all_gather_var_shape shape-to-list synchronization
Static Half layout pre-packing of original parameters (layout only, same values)
